en.tools.title: AI Tools
en.tools.desc: A working directory of AI tools. Each entry comes with an honest note on when not to use it — the part most directories leave out.
en.models.title: Model Library
en.models.desc: AI models compared on the dimensions that stay stable: what they are best at, what to watch out for, and who they suit.
en.models.note:
The comparison dimensions keep only what stays stable — biggest strength, what to watch, best for, open or closed, accessible from China, tier. These do not go stale in a few months.

Fast-moving information sits on its own "As of" line on each card, with the verification month printed, so you can judge how old it is.

That line is compiled from public sources and lags reality; version numbers frequently conflict between sources, so we removed the ones we could not confirm. For accurate versions, pricing and context length, use the "Model list" link at the bottom of each card and check the official page.
en.about.title: About
en.about.scope: This English section covers the tool directory, the model library, the scenario playbooks, the prompt library, the glossary and site search. The news feed and the learning resources are the two modules still in Chinese only — you can browse both in the Chinese version.
